note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI declares a charge with an 8% success chance at a target about 10.6 in away. Failure wastes the unit's turn and its position. Fix: Multiply every positive charge benefit (damage, wipe, halve, tie-up, plan-lock) by the charge probability. Add a 'no charge' option with score 0. Reject any charge below roughly 25% success unless the expected value is clearly positive. Add the cost of leaving cover or an objective area, and the overwatch damage taken, as costs that apply whatever the roll.
